title: Yeasty Pillowy Irish Potato Bake
description: A kid-friendly twist on traditional Irish potato bread, made with a tender beurre-monte and pillowy texture
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together warm milk and yeast, letting it sit for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine potatoes, egg, sugar, and salt. Mash until smooth.
Add flour to potato mixture, stirring until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Roll out the risen dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Spread the beurre-monte mixture evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll the dough into a tight log, starting from the long side. Cut into 8-10 slices.
Place the slices in a greased 9x13 baking dish, leaving about 1 inch of space between each slice.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown and puffed.
Serve warm, dust with powdered sugar if desired.
Let cool for at least 10 minutes before slicing.
Optional: drizzle with melted butter or sprinkle with chopped fresh herbs like chives or parsley.
Cut into slices and serve hot.
Let the potato bake cool on a wire rack for at least 5 minutes before serving.
Place the potato bake on a serving platter, slice, and serve immediately.
This potato bake is perfect for a comforting breakfast or brunch on a chilly morning.
Serve warm with a pat of butter or a dollop of whipped cream, if desired.
Let the potato bake rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Slice and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs or a sprinkle of powdered sugar.
